checkGroups.label: Relationships & Communities
checkGroups.description: Broken references, isolated areas and fragile paths between knowledge regions.

checks.label: Island Communities
checks.description: Find knowledge regions with no verified connection to the rest of the Vault.

checks.label: Fragile bridges
checks.description: Find important regions connected through too few notes or references.

checks.label: Missing backlinks
checks.description: Find one-way references that are missing expected return context.

checks.label: Weakly connected notes
checks.description: Find notes whose current connections provide little usable context.

checks.label: Unconnected notes
checks.description: Find notes outside the current verified knowledge structure.

checks.label: Broken links
checks.description: Find references whose exact target cannot be resolved.

checkGroups.label: Content health
checkGroups.description: Readable content, note shape, metadata and duplicated material.

checks.label: Empty notes
checks.description: Find notes with no meaningful readable content.

checks.label: Oversized notes
checks.description: Find notes large enough to benefit from an owner-reviewed split.

checks.label: Missing properties
checks.description: Find notes that do not have the expected frontmatter block.

checks.label: Unclear names
checks.description: Find temporary or malformed note names that need owner intent.

checks.label: Duplicate content
checks.description: Find notes with substantially duplicated readable content.

checks.label: Incomplete notes
checks.description: Find short notes that appear unfinished rather than intentionally concise.

checkGroups.label: Knowledge Index
checkGroups.description: Deterministic tag-shape tasks that complement rebuildable machine Index outputs.

checks.label: Too many tags
checks.description: Find notes whose tag count is far above the Vault baseline.

checks.label: Untagged notes
checks.description: Find notes without user-authored tags where the current policy expects them.

checkGroups.label: Reviewable follow-up
checkGroups.description: Stale folders, Communities, bridges and Hub summaries that may require owner review.

checks.label: Inactive folders
checks.description: Find folders whose contents have not changed within the configured window.

checks.label: Inactive Communities
checks.description: Find knowledge regions whose members have stopped changing.

checks.label: Recent drift
checks.description: Find recent notes moving away from their established knowledge region.

checks.label: Decaying bridges
checks.description: Find important cross-Community connections losing current support.

checks.label: Stale Hub notes
checks.description: Find Community index notes that no longer reflect their current members.

scanOperations.label: Embedding refresh
scanOperations.description: Build vectors after full-text passages and chunks are ready.

scanOperations.label: File summaries
scanOperations.description: Refresh machine summaries used by Search and maintenance context.

scanOperations.label: AI Tags and entities
scanOperations.description: Generate rebuildable machine-only knowledge without editing Markdown or YAML.

scanOperations.label: Relationship review
scanOperations.description: Review changed sources and cross-Community connections.

scanOperations.label: Community analysis
scanOperations.description: Explain current Communities, Hubs and bridge evidence.

scanOperations.label: Proposal evidence
scanOperations.description: Generate review evidence that may support a later file proposal; this Run does not create or apply a writable diff.

scanOperations.label: Maintenance synthesis
scanOperations.description: Keep only follow-up with a real owner action.
